protocol.name: lucent_glass_v1

description.summary: glass drawn by the compositor behind parts of a surface

protocol.description:
A client that draws frosted glass has to blur what is behind its surface. Doing that from a screen capture is always at least one frame late. With this protocol the client only says where the glass is and what it looks like, and the compositor draws it, under the surface's own content, from what is behind the surface in the very same frame.
The client leaves the glass area of its buffer transparent (or draws over it what belongs on top of the glass: text, a tint, highlights).
Warning: this protocol is experimental and may change in incompatible ways.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Glass objects made from it stay valid.

request.name: get_glass

description.summary: make a piece of glass for a surface

request.description: Makes a piece of glass behind the given surface. A surface may have several; they are drawn in the order they were made. A new piece has no region and is not drawn until one is set and the surface is committed.

interface.name: lucent_glass_v1

description.summary: one piece of glass behind a surface

interface.description: All state set here is double-buffered: it takes effect with the next wl_surface.commit of the surface, together with that commit's buffer.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The glass is no longer drawn. Takes effect at once.

request.name: set_region
request.description: A rectangle in surface-local coordinates. A width or height of zero means the glass is not drawn.

request.name: set_blur

description.summary: how strongly the background is blurred

request.description: radius: the sigma of a gaussian blur, in surface-local units. Zero: no blur. max_taps: the most samples per side the compositor should spend on each blur pass; a wider blur spreads them out. Zero: the compositor's default.
